question: When selecting multiple rules at once on FortiSIEM, which actions can you perform? A. You can change the severity, activate, or deactivate multiple rules at a time. B. You can view, edit, or activate only one rule at a time C. You can only activate or deactivate multiple rules at a time. D. You can only change the severity of multiple rules at a time.

Rules on FortiSIEM are usually processed as events are collected (streaming). How can you create a rule to evaluate events over an 8-hour period? A. Configure a report to run the analytical query and run the report every 8 hours. B. Configure a crontab process on the FortiSIEM supervisor. C. Configure a 28,000-second time window under the Define Conditions tab. D. Set the Evaluation Mode to Scheduled under the General tab.
